## Publication Information

**Date:** 1850

**Genre:** Fiction

**Publisher:** John and Charles Mozley, Paternoster Row, London, and Joseph Masters, New Bond Street, London.

**Notes:** Twenty-seven Langley stories were published in the <i>Magazine for the Young</i> of which fifteen were reprinted in <i>Langley School.</i>
